value.answer: Ear pulling and crying at night is often an ear infection in toddlers, though a cold or teething can look similar. Many ear infections clear on their own, and a lukewarm cloth on the ear may ease the pain. I can't see your child, so this is a best guess.
value.triage: Call 811 if the pain lasts more than a day or two, or if fluid or pus drains from the ear. Go to the ER or call 911 now for a stiff neck, unsteady walking, swelling behind the ear, a crooked smile, or fever over 40C.
